name: indian-banking-drafting
description: Open-source Claude-compatible plugin for drafting Indian banking and financial litigation pleadings. Case-config-aware design — the plugin's structural skeletons are uniform across pleading types, and the parties' chosen forum (Debts Recovery Tribunal bench / Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal / National Company Law Tribunal bench / Chief Metropolitan Magistrate / District Magistrate / civil court of pecuniary jurisdiction), security position, NPA classification, demand-notice trajectory, default trigger, and security-document inventory are supplied by the user via a case-config file. Drafting workflows for DRT Original Application under Section 19 of the RDDBFI Act 1993, SARFAESI Section 13(2) demand notice, SARFAESI Section 17 Securitisation Application, SARFAESI Section 14 application before CMM / DM for possession assistance, Negotiable Instruments Act Section 138 complaint, Section 138 reply notice, civil recovery suit under Order 7 / Order 37 CPC, IBC Section 7 financial-creditor application before NCLT, IBC Section 95 personal-guarantor insolvency application, and DRAT appeal under Section 20 of the RDDBFI Act 1993. Includes the 6-agent drafting pipeline (Reader -> Format -> Drafter -> Verifier -> Refiner -> Overseer), shared banking drafting base with RDDBFI Act 1993 + SARFAESI Act 2002 + Negotiable Instruments Act 1881 + Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 + Banking Regulation Act 1949 + RBI Master Directions + Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 + Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 discipline encoded.
